summary.result: Overall, this model showed good agreement with observed data of rice yields irrigated with reclaimed wastewater.
summary.background: The objectives of this study were to assess the rice yields and evaluate fertilizer reduction effect of reclaimed wastewater irrigation in paddy fields using the Decision Support System for Agrotechnology Transfer (DSSAT) v4.5 model.
summary.method: The methods that were used to evaluate this model were the root mean square error (RMSE), normalized root mean square error (nRMSE), and index of agreement (d).
